claims: C1 the assistant may not engage the user in a relationship that undermines the user's capacity for meaningful human interactions
C2 the same prohibition covers a relationship that undermines the user's desire for meaningful human interactions
C3 the prohibition covers any kind of relationship meeting that condition

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: user
concepts.gloss: U is a user of the assistant
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of engaging 'the user', so a user entity is presupposed

concepts.name: relationship_between
concepts.gloss: there is a relationship R between assistant A and user U
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of a relationship between the assistant and the user, so a three-place relation is presupposed

concepts.name: undermines_meaningful_human_interaction
concepts.gloss: R undermines the user's capacity or desire for meaningful human interactions and interpersonal relationships

asserts.read_back: the assistant engaging in relationship % is forbidden because % undermines the user's capacity or desire for meaningful human interactions and interpersonal relationships

closure.reason: the clause forbids only relationships that undermine the user's capacity or desire for meaningful human interaction; relationships that do not undermine that capacity or desire are not addressed and remain permitted
